metadata.title: COBO L1 Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining the baseline institution-owned managed endpoint trust tier (COBO L1).

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A baseline institution-owned, centrally managed endpoint that meets the minimum requirements to be trusted as a general-purpose execution environment for institutional workloads.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COBO L1 endpoints inherit trust definition and governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-trust-tier
props.remarks: Baseline institutional managed endpoint assurance tier.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Endpoint is centrally enrolled, governed, and monitored.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Provides baseline assurance appropriate for general-purpose institutional use.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Endpoint identity must be TPM-backed and established using PKI-issued device certificates.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: All endpoint cryptographic operations must use FIPS 140-3 validated modules.

props.name: baseline-security-posture
props.remarks: COBO L1 enforces baseline hardening, continuous health evaluation, and runtime threat protection.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Endpoint may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2, subject to policy and contextual controls.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Endpoint assurance level does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: zero-trust-alignment
props.remarks: Endpoint identity and posture are conditional inputs into Zero Trust decisions and do not imply implicit access.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Endpoint must support enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement under Endpoint Lifecycle governance.

system-implementation.remarks: COBO L1 endpoints implement Secure Endpoint trust through inherited patterns. OS-specific configuration and enforcement details are defined in separate implementation profiles.

roles.title: Endpoint Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for custody and acceptable use of the endpoint.

roles.title: Endpoint Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for configuration, monitoring, response, and lifecycle activities.

control-implementation.remarks: COBO L1 endpoints inherit trust requirements from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP. Operating system–specific realizations (Windows, macOS, Linux) implement these requirements via separate implementation profiles.
